title: Zero to Million - Episode 9
caption:
Episode 9 of Zero to Million. 📦💸

You picked: take all 5,000 flyers. They paid $15,000. Balance: $15,257. Then Stick got bored of flyers and bid $2,000 on an abandoned storage unit (balance $13,257). Inside: an old car and a locked safe. He sold the car at auction for $8,000. Balance: $21,257. Then the safe started to beep.

Next vote: A) Crack the safe open (balance stays $21,257 for now). B) Sell it unopened for $3,000 (balance $24,257).

Comment A or B. Tag a friend who would open the safe. Follow for Episode 10!
